question: Two point charges $+4.0\ \mu\text{C}$ and $-2.0\ \mu\text{C}$ are separated by $30\text{ cm}$. Determine the electric field and electric potential at the midpoint of the line joining them. Also calculate the work done in bringing a charge $+1.0\ \mu\text{C}$ from infinity to this midpoint.

options.B: At midpoint, $E=2.4\times10^6\text{ N C}^{-1}$ towards positive charge, $V=-1.2\times10^5\text{ V}$, and $W=-0.12\text{ J}$.
options.D: At the midpoint, both field contributions point towards the negative charge, so $E=k\dfrac{(4.0+2.0)\times10^{-6}}{0.15^2}=2.4\times10^6\text{ N C}^{-1}$ towards the negative charge. Potential is $V=k\left(\dfrac{4.0\times10^{-6}}{0.15}-\dfrac{2.0\times10^{-6}}{0.15}\right)=1.2\times10^5\text{ V}$. Work to bring $+1.0\ \mu\text{C}$ is $W=qV=0.12\text{ J}$.
